info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Order Retrieval API
info.description: The Servicing Order Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific servicing orders within the banking system. By using the provided order identifier, consumers can retrieve the status, history, and associated details of a servicing order. This API is particularly useful for customer service representatives and automated systems requiring real-time order data. It plays a critical role in ensuring efficient customer support and service management.

get.summary: Retrieve a servicing order by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve detailed information about a specific servicing order using its unique identifier (RES-100045). It provides essential data related to the servicing order, facilitating further actions or insights.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve servicing order details for a specific order ID (RES-100045). It requires a JSON object that adheres to the defined schema, containing information necessary for the operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the servicing order details.
